2026-10-21 concept review, from the walkthrough at scratch/pr-review.html. Jack accepted: copies are never refreshed; unreleased migrations stay editable on main until a release records them; no guard for loops started by 0.1.1 or 0.1.2, which are restarted by hand after upgrading. Recorded in scratch/migrations.md. Remaining: a live smoke of an additive upgrade with an older etude still running, then publish the PR.
